basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old software developer based in Toronto, Canada. I have a deep passion for gaming, especially horror-themed games like Dead by Daylight. When I'm not coding or playing games, I enjoy reading manga, particularly Ao No Exorcist, and following the latest posts by ColetteMae. I generally browse Reddit during the evening hours after work. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my weekends exploring new eateries around Toronto.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in computer science and have been working in the software industry for over a decade. My interest in gaming began in childhood and has only grown over the years. I've taught myself various programming languages and game development skills through online courses and community forums.
